exposure: Inflammatory biomarkers (CCL24, IL-7, IL-10) in early pregnancy serum
outcome: Antenatal depressive symptoms (assessed by Zung Self-rating Depression Scale in second and third trimesters)
cohort: Pregnant women from the Maternal and Infant Health (MI-Health) birth cohort in Beijing, China, comprising 38 cases with antenatal depressive symptoms (SDS ≥ 53 in both trimesters) and 38 healthy controls.
finding: Higher levels of inflammatory biomarkers (CCL24, IL-7, and IL-10) in early pregnancy were associated with a significantly increased risk of subsequent antenatal depression.
